plan.summary: This 1-4 block is the opening build phase for an off-camp 12-week boxing plan with one S&C session per week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so percentage work is grounded before the main program starts in Week 2. With only one weekly session and a request for more conditioning, each day keeps a simple full-body structure: explosive work first, main strength second, practical accessories after, then short conditioning that supports boxing without creating excess soreness.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and power with simple repeatable lifts while keeping a steady boxing-friendly conditioning dose.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and power output with slightly heavier work while trimming any volume that clashes with boxing load.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it faster through crisp explosive work and lower-fatigue conditioning.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height you can land on quietly and cleanly. Reset between reps and keep each jump fast.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if box setup is limited. Jump for height and stick the landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only and keep the reps crisp.

exercises.name: Back Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up in small jumps, then work up to one hard top set with solid depth and control. Stop if form breaks down.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. This establishes your baseline for future percentage work.
